name.description: Name or title of the form displayed to users and administrators. Should be descriptive and clearly indicate the form's purpose or the type of data it collects.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the form's purpose, intended audience, or usage instructions. Provides additional context for form administrators and can be displayed to users as introductory text.
description.example: Complete this form to begin the customer onboarding process. All required fields must be filled accurately.

sections.description: Ordered list of form sections that structure the form content. Sections provide logical grouping of related fields and can contain subsections for hierarchical organization. The order in this list determines the display sequence in the form interface.

type.description: Classification type of the document or form template. Defines the category and processing rules for this form within the document management system.

documentId.description: Unique identifier of the document template associated with this form. Links the form to a specific PDF template or document structure for rendering and data population. Must be a valid UUID format.

document.description: Complete document object associated with this form, if available. Contains the full document metadata, template information, and file details. Provides rich document context beyond just the document ID reference.

conditionalRules.description: List of conditional logic rules that control dynamic form behavior. Rules define when and how form elements should change based on user input or form state. Enables sophisticated interactions like showing/hiding fields, setting values, and modifying validation rules.

domains.description: Domain entity types this form pulls data from. Each domain's alias is the path prefix for field value paths.

FormFieldDto.description: Data Transfer Object representing a single form field for data collection. Fields are the fundamental input elements that users interact with to provide information. Supports various field types, validation rules, and integration with PDF documents.

name.description: Name or label of the form field displayed to users. Should be clear and descriptive to help users understand what information is expected. Also serves as the unique identifier for the field within the form.

fieldType.description: Type of input control that determines how users interact with the field. Each type provides different input capabilities and validation behaviors.

associatedText.description: Additional descriptive text or instructions associated with the field. Can provide context, examples, or detailed guidance to help users complete the field correctly.
associatedText.example: Enter your full legal name as it appears on government-issued identification

displayOrder.description: Display order for this field within its parent section or subsection. Used for drag-and-drop reordering in the form builder.

page.description: Page number where this field appears in multi-page forms or documents. Used for organizing complex forms and coordinating with PDF page layouts.

maxLength.description: Maximum number of characters allowed in this field. Enforces input length limits for data validation and storage constraints. Set to 0 for no limit.

minLength.description: Minimum number of characters required in this field. Ensures input meets minimum length requirements for data quality. Set to 0 for no minimum.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text displayed in empty fields to guide user input. Provides hints about the expected format or content without being a default value.

helpText.description: Help text providing additional guidance or context for the field. Can be displayed as tooltips, help bubbles, or explanatory text near the field.
helpText.example: Your name must match exactly what appears on your identification documents

required.description: Whether this field must be completed before the form can be submitted. Required fields are typically marked with visual indicators like asterisks.

readonly.description: Whether this field is read-only and cannot be edited by users. Useful for displaying calculated values, system-generated data, or pre-filled information.

validationPattern.description: Regular expression pattern for validating field input. Enables custom validation rules beyond basic field type validation. Pattern must match the entire field value for validation to pass.

validationMessage.description: Custom error message displayed when field validation fails. Provides user-friendly feedback when input doesn't meet validation requirements.
validationMessage.example: Name must contain only letters and spaces

defaultValue.description: Default value pre-populated in the field when the form loads. Users can modify this value unless the field is read-only.

fieldValue.description: Current value entered or selected in the field. Represents the user's input or system-assigned value for this field.

obtainValueFromPath.description: Object path expression for automatically obtaining field values from data sources. Uses dot notation to navigate object properties (e.g., 'customer.address.zipCode'). Enables dynamic field population from external data.

list.description: Configuration for list-based fields like dropdowns, radio buttons, and checkboxes. Defines the available options and selection behavior for choice-based fields.

pdfField.description: PDF-specific field mapping information for document generation and population. Links this form field to specific locations and properties within PDF documents.

FormFieldListDto.description: Data Transfer Object for form field list configuration used in dropdown menus, radio button groups, checkbox lists, and multi-select fields. Defines the available options and selection behavior for choice-based form fields.

optionsEnum.description: Name of the Java enum class associated with the list options. Provides type-safe option management and enables automatic option generation from enum values. When specified, the system can validate selections against the enum and provide consistent option sets.

allowMultiple.description: Whether users can select multiple options from this list. Controls the field's selection behavior and UI presentation: • true: Enables checkboxes or multi-select dropdowns for multiple selections • false: Restricts to radio buttons or single-select dropdowns for one choice only

options.description: List of individual selectable options available in this field. Each option contains a value for data storage, display text for users, and optional metadata. The order of options in this list determines their display sequence in the form interface.

FormFieldPdfDto.description: Data Transfer Object for PDF field mapping information that connects form fields to specific locations and properties within PDF documents. Enables automatic population of PDF forms with data collected through web forms and precise positioning for form-to-PDF integration.

id.description: Unique identifier for the pdf field

text.description: Text content or label associated with the PDF field. Typically represents the field name, caption, or descriptive text as it appears in the PDF document.

toolTipText.description: Tooltip text that appears when users hover over the PDF field. Provides additional guidance, context, or instructions for completing the field within the PDF.
toolTipText.example: Enter your full legal name as it appears on your identification documents

rectWidth.description: Width of the PDF field rectangle in points (1/72 inch). Defines the horizontal size of the input area within the PDF document layout.

rectHeight.description: Height of the PDF field rectangle in points (1/72 inch). Defines the vertical size of the input area within the PDF document layout.

rectX.description: X-coordinate position of the PDF field's left edge in points, measured from the left edge of the page. Provides precise horizontal positioning for the field within the PDF coordinate system.

rectY.description: Y-coordinate position of the PDF field's bottom edge in points, measured from the bottom of the page. PDF coordinate system has origin at bottom-left corner, unlike typical screen coordinate systems. Provides precise vertical positioning for the field.

pageNumber.description: Page number in the PDF document where this field appears. Page numbering starts from 1 for the first page. Used for multi-page PDF form coordination.

object.description: Serialized PDF field object containing the complete technical representation of the PDF field. Stores the full field definition including properties, constraints, formatting, and behavior information as extracted from or to be applied to the PDF document. Typically contains JSON or XML representation.

listOptionValue.description: Selected option value for list-based PDF fields such as dropdowns, radio buttons, or checkboxes. Represents the currently chosen option from the available choices defined in the PDF field. Used to maintain selection state when populating or reading from PDF forms.

totalIncome.description: Total income received across all positions (dividends, interest, distributions). Cumulative amount since position inception. Updated when income is received.

accruedIncome.description: Total accrued income across all positions (earned but not yet paid). Primarily applies to fixed income (bond coupon accrual) and real estate (rent accrual). Updated daily for bonds. Not applicable to equity dividends which don't accrue.

estimatedAnnualIncome.description: Estimated annual income based on current holdings. Sum of: (DPS × shares) for equities, (face × coupon rate) for bonds, distribution estimates for funds, rental income for real estate. Forward-looking projection, may differ from actual income received.

weightedAvgYieldPct.description: Weighted average yield percentage across all positions. Calculated as: (sum of estimatedAnnualIncome) / totalMarketValue × 100. Represents the blended yield of the entire account.

totalFees.description: Total fees paid across all positions (sum of all fee categories). Includes management, advisory, performance, transaction, custodian, and other fees. Critical for calculating net performance and fee drag.

managementFees.description: Total management fees paid for asset management services. Typically 0.25% - 2.00% of AUM annually, charged quarterly or annually.

advisoryFees.description: Total advisory fees paid for financial advisor services. Typically 0.25% - 1.50% of AUM annually. Separate from management fees.

performanceFees.description: Total performance fees paid (incentive fees, carried interest). Common in alternative investments (hedge funds, PE). Typically 10-20% of gains above hurdle.

transactionFees.description: Total transaction fees paid for trade execution (commissions, SEC fees, exchange fees). Varies by broker and trade volume. Modern brokers often charge $0 for equity trades.

custodianFees.description: Total custodian fees paid for safekeeping and administration of assets. Typically $25-$500 per year depending on account size and custodian.

otherFees.description: Total other fees not categorized above (regulatory fees, data feeds, wire fees, etc.).

lastValuationDate.description: Most recent valuation date across all portfolios. Indicates when the account's positions were last valued/priced. Stale valuation dates may indicate pricing issues.

AccountPortfolioSummaryDto.description: Portfolio sleeve summary for embedding in parent entities. Provides key portfolio metrics (market value, cost basis, P&L, position count) without full position details. Used in AccountFinancial responses to show a summary of each portfolio sleeve within the account.

name.description: Portfolio name or sleeve designation. Common naming conventions: 'Core', 'Growth', 'Income', 'Alternatives', or manager-specific names like 'BlackRock Growth'.

status.description: Current operational status of the portfolio sleeve. ACTIVE = normal operations, INACTIVE = temporarily suspended, CLOSED = permanently closed, PENDING_SETUP = awaiting initial configuration.

totalMarketValue.description: Current total market value of all positions in the portfolio. Calculated as sum of (quantity × current price) for each position. Includes cash, securities, and other holdings. Currency matches portfolio base currency.

totalCostBasis.description: Total cost basis (original purchase price) across all positions. Used to calculate unrealized gains/losses. Includes transaction costs and adjustments. Cost basis method (FIFO, LIFO, specific lot) is configured at the portfolio level.

totalUnrealizedPnl.description: Total unrealized profit/loss across all open positions. Calculated as: totalMarketValue - totalCostBasis. Positive = gain, Negative = loss. Does not include realized P&L from closed positions.

totalRealizedPnl.description: Total realized profit/loss from closed positions (year-to-date or lifetime, depending on portfolio configuration). Includes gains/losses from sales, redemptions, and corporate actions. Updated when positions are closed.

positionCount.description: Number of distinct positions (holdings) in the portfolio. Includes all asset types: equities, fixed income, alternatives, cash. Useful for understanding portfolio concentration and complexity.

totalIncome.description: Total income received from all positions (dividends, interest, distributions). Cumulative amount since position inception.

accruedIncome.description: Accrued income across all positions (earned but not yet paid). Primarily bond coupon accruals and real estate rent.

estimatedAnnualIncome.description: Estimated annual income from all positions. Forward-looking projection based on current holdings.

totalFees.description: Total fees paid across all positions (sum of all fee categories).

managementFees.description: Management fees for asset management services.

advisoryFees.description: Advisory fees for financial advisor services.

custodianFees.description: Custodian fees for safekeeping and administration.

return1m.description:
1-month rolling return percentage.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 1 month) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) × 100`

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

**Example:** If current MV is $1,050,000 and 1-month-ago MV was $1,000,000, return1m = 5.00%

return3m.description:
3-month rolling return percentage.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 3 months) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) × 100`

**Use case:** Quarterly performance assessment, comparing against benchmarks.

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

return6m.description:
6-month rolling return percentage.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 6 months) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) × 100`

**Use case:** Semi-annual performance review, trend analysis.

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

return1y.description:
1-year rolling return percentage.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 1 year) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) × 100`

**Use case:** Annual performance comparison, benchmark analysis, client reporting.

**Note:** This is a simple return (not annualized). The actual lookback may differ by a few days
due to weekends/holidays when the exact date has no valuation.

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

AccountSnapshotDto.description:
Snapshot of an account in the household universe at valuation date.

Represents a financial account discovered via recursive ownership traversal
from the household through all members and intermediate entities.

**Discovery:** Uses recursive CTE to traverse Household → Members → LegalEntities → Accounts

**Joint Accounts:** Appear once per owner with their ownership percentage (e.g., 50%/50%).
This enables accurate fractional ownership reporting for tax and estate planning.

**Ownership Percentages:**
- Individual accounts: 100% (single owner)
- Joint accounts: Split (e.g., 50%/50%)
- Entity-owned: 100% (LegalEntity owns the account)

**Hierarchy:** Household → Members → (optional) LegalEntities → **Accounts** → Portfolios → Positions

accountName.description: Display name of the account, typically describing purpose or owner

accountNumber.description: External account number assigned by the custodian or institution

accountType.description:
Account type classification indicating the tax treatment and structure.

**Common values:** BROKERAGE, INDIVIDUAL_RETIREMENT, ROTH_IRA, 401K,
TRUST, JOINT, CUSTODIAL, 529_PLAN, HSA, CORPORATE

accountCategory.description:
High-level account category for grouping and reporting.

**Common values:** TAXABLE, TAX_DEFERRED, TAX_EXEMPT, RETIREMENT, EDUCATION, HEALTH

ownerEntityType.description:
Entity type of the account owner.

- **INDIVIDUAL**: Account owned by a natural person (household member)
- **LEGAL_ENTITY**: Account owned by a trust, LLC, corporation, or other legal structure

ownerEntityId.description: Unique identifier of the owning entity (Individual or LegalEntity)

ownerName.description: Display name of the account owner

ownershipPct.description:
Ownership percentage of this account by the owner (0-100).

For individual accounts: typically 100%
For joint accounts: typically 50% per owner (account appears once per owner)

**Example:** John owns 50% of "Smith Joint Account" - ownershipPct = 50.00

marketValue.description:
Total current market value of all positions in the account.

**Calculation:** SUM(position.quantity × position.currentPrice) for all positions.
Includes equities, fixed income, alternatives, and cash equivalents.

costBasis.description:
Total cost basis of all positions in the account.

**Calculation:** SUM(position.quantity × position.averageCost) for all positions.
Used for calculating unrealized gains/losses and tax implications.

unrealizedPnl.description:
Total unrealized profit/loss for the account.

**Calculation:** marketValue - costBasis

Positive values indicate gains; negative values indicate losses.
Does not include realized gains from closed positions.

unrealizedPnlPct.description:
Unrealized P&L as a percentage of cost basis.

**Calculation:** (unrealizedPnl / costBasis) × 100

Useful for comparing performance across accounts of different sizes.

cashBalance.description:
Cash and cash equivalents available in the account.

Includes money market funds, sweep accounts, and uninvested cash.
This is a subset of marketValue, not additional to it.

positionCount.description:
Total number of distinct positions (holdings) in the account.

Each unique security or instrument held counts as one position,
regardless of tax lots or purchase dates.

portfolioCount.description:
Number of portfolio sleeves (AccountPortfolio) within this account.

Portfolio sleeves allow an account to be divided into separately managed
segments, each potentially following a different model portfolio or strategy.

custodianName.description:
Name of the custodian or financial institution holding the account.

The custodian is responsible for safekeeping assets and executing transactions.

**Common custodians:** Charles Schwab, Fidelity, TD Ameritrade, Pershing,
Northern Trust, State Street, BNY Mellon

HouseholdValuationDto.description:
Daily valuation snapshot for a Household (family group) - top of the valuation hierarchy.

Aggregates the ownership-weighted net worth of all member entities (Individuals and LegalEntities).
Each member's contribution is weighted by the household's ownership percentage of that member.

**Position in Hierarchy:** Position → Portfolio → Account → Owner → **Household**

**Calculation:** totalMarketValue = SUM(member.netWorth × memberOwnershipPct / 100)

dayReturn.description: Daily return percentage. Formula: (todayMV - yesterdayMV) / yesterdayMV × 100

return1m.description:
1-month rolling return percentage for the household.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 1 month) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) × 100`

**Scope:** Aggregates all household members' ownership-weighted values.

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

**Example:** If current household MV is $3,150,000 and 1-month-ago MV was $3,000,000, return1m = 5.00%

return3m.description:
3-month rolling return percentage for the household.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 3 months) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) × 100`

**Use case:** Quarterly family wealth review, comparing household performance against benchmarks.

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

return6m.description:
6-month rolling return percentage for the household.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 6 months) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) × 100`

**Use case:** Semi-annual family wealth review, trend analysis across the household.

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

return1y.description:
1-year rolling return percentage for the household.

**Calculation:** Finds the valuation on or before (valuationDate - 1 year) and computes:
`((currentMV - baselineMV) / baselineMV) × 100`

**Use case:** Annual family wealth performance, year-over-year comparison, client reporting.

**Note:** This is a simple return (not annualized). The actual lookback may differ by a few days
due to weekends/holidays when the exact date has no valuation.

**Null when:** No historical valuation exists for the lookback period.

ownedAccounts.description:
All accounts in the household universe - the complete inventory of accounts owned
by household members or entities within the ownership hierarchy.

**Household Universe Traversal:**

Uses recursive ownership chain traversal to capture ALL accounts, including those
owned through intermediate Legal Entities (trusts, LLCs, holding companies).

```
Household → Individual → Account (direct ownership)
Household → Individual → LegalEntity (Trust) → Account (nested ownership)
Household → LegalEntity → Account (entity-owned)
```

**Joint Account Handling:**

Joint accounts appear ONCE PER OWNER with their respective ownership percentage:
- "Smith Joint Brokerage" owned 50% by Robert Smith
- "Smith Joint Brokerage" owned 50% by Margaret Smith

This enables accurate reporting of fractional ownership and tax attribution.

**What's Included:**
- Accounts directly owned by household Individuals
- Accounts owned by household LegalEntities
- Accounts owned by LegalEntities that are themselves owned by household members
- Joint accounts (appearing once per co-owner with ownership %)

**What's NOT Included:**
- Accounts outside the household ownership hierarchy
- Accounts with terminated ownership relationships

**Use Cases:**
- Complete account inventory for household
- Joint account identification for tax planning
- Understanding nested ownership structures
- Consolidated reporting across all family accounts

MoveSubSectionRequest.description: Request to move or reorder a subsection within or between parent sections. Set sourceSectionId == targetSectionId for a simple reorder within the same section. Generation.description: A single generation within the household, containing individuals at the same level in the family tree. Generation 1 is the oldest (founders), with subsequent generations numbered incrementally.

items.description: Individuals in this generation, sorted alphabetically by last name, then first name

HouseholdGenerations.description: Individuals within a household organized by family generation. Generation 1 represents the oldest/founding generation (those with no parents in the household). Subsequent generations are numbered incrementally based on parent-child relationships. Spouses share the same generation as their partner.

totalIndividuals.description: Total count of individuals owned by this household (includes both assigned and unassigned)

totalGenerations.description: Number of distinct generations identified through family relationships. Does not count unassigned individuals.

generations.description: List of generations ordered from oldest (1) to youngest. Each generation contains individuals at that level of the family tree. Empty if no family relationships exist.

items.description: List of generations ordered from oldest (1) to youngest. Each generation contains individuals at that level of the family tree. Empty if no family relationships exist.

unassigned.description: Individuals owned by the household but without family relationships. These members could not be assigned to a generation because they have no PARENT, CHILD, SPOUSE, or SIBLING relationships with other household members. Common for newly added members or non-family associates.

items.description: Individuals owned by the household but without family relationships. These members could not be assigned to a generation because they have no PARENT, CHILD, SPOUSE, or SIBLING relationships with other household members. Common for newly added members or non-family associates.

DriftAnalysisDto.description: Drift analysis comparing actual portfolio holdings to target strategy allocations. Provides detailed breakdown by asset class and sub-asset class with rebalancing recommendations.

entityId.description: Unique identifier of the entity being analyzed (portfolio ID or account ID)

entityName.description: Display name of the entity being analyzed

analysisType.description: Type of analysis: PORTFOLIO_VS_MODEL compares a portfolio to its model, ACCOUNT_VS_STRATEGY compares aggregated account holdings to the account's strategy

referenceId.description: ID of the reference strategy used for target allocations

hasReference.description: Whether a valid reference (model portfolio or strategy) was found. If false, drift analysis cannot be performed - check the message field for details.

message.description: Informational message explaining the analysis result, especially when no reference is available or portfolio has zero value
message.example: No model portfolio assigned to this portfolio. Assign a model portfolio to enable drift analysis.

totalMarketValue.description: Total market value of all positions analyzed (in account currency)

analysisDate.description: Timestamp when the drift analysis was calculated

overallDriftScore.description: Overall drift score (0-100): average absolute deviation from targets across asset classes. Lower is better. Score of 0 = perfect alignment. Scores >5% typically warrant review.

rebalancingRecommended.description: Whether rebalancing is recommended based on drift exceeding strategy-defined thresholds

assetClassDrifts.description: Per-asset-class drift breakdown, sorted by absolute drift (highest first)

subAssetClassDrifts.description: Per-sub-asset-class drift breakdown, sorted by absolute drift (highest first)

summary.description: Summary statistics including max drift, classes needing rebalancing, and unclassified holdings

DriftSummary.description: Summary statistics providing high-level drift metrics for quick assessment

assetClassCount.description: Number of asset classes included in the analysis

assetClassesNeedingRebalancing.description: Count of asset classes where drift exceeds the rebalancing threshold

maxAssetClassDrift.description: Highest absolute drift percentage among all asset classes

maxDriftAssetClass.description: Asset class with the largest drift from target

avgAssetClassDrift.description: Average absolute drift across all asset classes (same as overallDriftScore)

subAssetClassCount.description: Number of sub-asset classes included in the analysis

maxSubAssetClassDrift.description: Highest absolute drift percentage among all sub-asset classes

maxDriftSubAssetClass.description: Sub-asset class with the largest drift from target

totalRebalanceValue.description: Total market value that would need to be rebalanced (sum of |valueDifference| for classes exceeding threshold)

unclassifiedPct.description: Percentage of portfolio in positions without asset class classification. High values may indicate instrument data quality issues.

unclassifiedValue.description: Market value of positions without asset class classification

SubAssetClassDrift.description: Drift analysis for a single sub-asset class providing granular allocation tracking

parentAssetClass.description: Parent asset class containing this sub-asset class

actualPct.description: Actual allocation percentage based on current position market values (0-100)

driftPct.description: Drift percentage (actual - target). Positive = overweight, negative = underweight

actualValue.description: Sum of market values of all positions in this sub-asset class

valueDifference.description: Value difference (actual - target). Positive = excess, negative = shortfall

direction.description: Direction of drift: OVERWEIGHT, UNDERWEIGHT, or ON_TARGET

PortfolioAllocationChartDto.description: Portfolio allocation data formatted for 3-level pie chart visualization

accountId.description: Account ID that owns this portfolio

totalMarketValue.description: Total market value of the portfolio

positionCount.description: Number of positions in the portfolio

strategyId.description: Strategy ID if portfolio is linked to a strategy

strategyName.description: Strategy name if portfolio is linked to a strategy

publicPrivateSeries.description: Public vs Private market allocations (innermost ring)

AccountPerformanceSummaryDto.description: Account-level performance summary combining position valuations with transaction aggregates. Designed for summary cards above the account detail view. Position data comes from the latest AccountValuation snapshot (or live aggregation as fallback). Fee and income metrics are aggregated from transactions within the requested date range. Annualization formula: toDateAmount * (365.25 / periodDays).

marketValue.description: Total market value of all positions

costBasis.description: Total cost basis of all positions

unrealizedPnlPercent.description: Unrealized P&L as percentage of cost basis

positionCount.description: Number of positions in the account

totalFees.description: Total fees in the queried period (negative value = fees paid)

feeTransactionCount.description: Number of fee transactions in the period

estimatedAnnualFees.description: Estimated annualized fees based on the queried period

totalIncome.description: Total income (dividends + interest) in the queried period

totalDividends.description: Total dividend income in the period

totalInterest.description: Total interest income in the period

incomeTransactionCount.description: Number of income transactions in the period

estimatedAnnualIncome.description: Estimated annualized income based on the queried period

netDeposits.description: Net deposits (deposits - withdrawals) in the period

realizedPnl.description: Realized P&L from sell transactions in the period

periodStart.description: Start of the period used for calculations

periodEnd.description: End of the period used for calculations

periodDays.description: Number of days in the period (used for annualization)

AccountAllocationChartDto.description: Account allocation data formatted for 3-level pie chart visualization

totalMarketValue.description: Total market value across all portfolios

portfolioCount.description: Number of portfolios in the account

totalPositionCount.description: Total number of positions across all portfolios

publicPrivateSeries.description: Public vs Private market allocations (innermost ring)

ModelPortfolioAllocationSummaryDto.description: Summary of a portfolio's allocation within the account

publicMarketPercentage.description: Public market percentage within this portfolio

privateMarketPercentage.description: Private market percentage within this portfolio

cashPercentage.description: Cash & equivalents percentage within this portfolio

SubCategoryEnumDto.description: Account subcategory with parent category, group, and tax status

value.description: Enum constant name (use this for API calls)

displayName.description: Human-readable display name

groupDisplayName.description: Group display name for UI headers

taxable.description: Whether accounts with this subcategory are taxable

normalized.description: Indicates if data was normalized to 100%

hasRanges.description: Indicates if ranges are used in the data

FundIndustryGroupChartDto.description: Fund industry group allocation chart data

normalized.description: Indicates if data was normalized to 100%

hasRanges.description: Indicates if ranges are used in the data

normalized.description: Indicates if data was normalized to 100%

hasRanges.description: Indicates if ranges are used in the data

deletedTargetLegalEntities.description: Relationships to deleted legal entities removed

deletedSourceLegalEntities.description: Relationships from deleted legal entities removed

ExternalIdCleanupResult.description: Result of orphaned external entity ID cleanup

totalDeleted.description: Total number of external entity IDs deleted

deletedIndividuals.description: External IDs to deleted individuals removed

deletedLegalEntities.description: External IDs to deleted legal entities removed

deletedHouseholds.description: External IDs to deleted households removed

deletedAccounts.description: External IDs to deleted accounts removed

FundPerformanceTargetDto.description: Target performance metrics of the fund
